mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_step (session_id, step_order, step_type, input_data, output_data, status, error_message, duration_ms) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{stepOrder}, #{stepType}, #{inputData}, #{outputData}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{durationMs})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, step_order, step_type, input_data, output_data, status, error_message, duration_ms, create_time FROM analysis_step WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY step_order
